paragraphs: The V220d is part of the current W447-generation V-Class range, which has been in production since 2014 and received a major refresh alongside the Vito in 2025. Under the bonnet, the V220d uses the OM654 — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel that's part of Mercedes' modern engine family. This is the same engine used across the wider current V-Class diesel range (V200/V220d/V250/V300d), replacing the older OM651 on earlier W447 models. The OM654 is a clean-sheet design introduced as a modular engine family, fitted across passenger cars and commercial vehicles with different power outputs.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every V220D on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the V220D from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
